idea: Rainy Tokyo alley at night. A red ramen stall with a sign that says OPEN LATE. One customer under a yellow umbrella.
Exactly three white cranes standing in shallow water at sunrise, with a dark mountain behind them. Ink wash painting.
A mechanic catches a falling silver wrench while standing beside an open engine bay. Low angle, documentary photo.
A small blue boat passes under a stone bridge. A red bicycle is parked on the bridge, not in the boat. Overcast daylight.
A cracked porcelain teacup repaired with visible gold seams on a rough wooden table. Close-up still life, soft side light.
A quiet empty subway platform at 2 a.m. No people and no train. Fluorescent ceiling lights, symmetrical composition.
An elderly woman in a green coat runs after a departing tram, reaching for a dropped red scarf. Candid street photograph.
Desert observatory during a snowstorm. One telescope dome open to the sky; orange emergency light reflected in snow. Wide frame.
Minimal poster for a fictional jazz club. The only visible words are BLUE HOUR, set large in cream letters on navy. A single trumpet silhouette.
A black cat watches a goldfish through the curved glass of a bowl. The cat is behind the bowl, and its reflection appears in the glass. Warm kitchen light.
Brutalist library interior with one long spiral staircase and sunlight forming a bright rectangle on the floor. No books floating. Architectural photograph.
Two adult astronauts exchange a paper map on a red Mars plain. One suit is blue, the other white. Their helmets stay on. Cinematic wide shot.
